runs.what: the slicing-by-8 tables generated from the bitwise loop (gen_tables.py), table 0 checked against the committed byte table
runs.command:
N=<SCRATCH>/next10; cat > $N/gen_tables.py <<'EOF'
"""The slicing-by-8 tables of zlib's CRC-32: T[0] the byte table (eight bitwise steps from each byte), T[k][n] the
state of T[k-1][n] after one more byte of zeros -- (T[k-1][n] >> 8) ^ T[0][T[k-1][n] & 0xFF]. Prints a C initializer."""

def bitwise(n):
    c = n
    for _ in range(8):
        c = (c >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320 & -(c & 1))
    return c & 0xFFFFFFFF


t = [[bitwise(n) for n in range(256)]]
for k in range(1, 8):
    t.append([(t[k - 1][n] >> 8) ^ t[0][t[k - 1][n] & 0xFF] for n in range(256)])
print("static const uint32_t bcir_crc_slice[8][256] = {")
for k in range(8):
    print("  {")
    for row in range(0, 256, 6):
        print("    " + " ".join(f"0x{v:08X}u," for v in t[k][row:row + 6]))
    print("  },")
print("};")
EOF
python3 $N/gen_tables.py > $N/tables.inc; wc -l $N/tables.inc; head -4 $N/tables.inc
cd <REPO> && python3 - <<'EOF'
# the committed byte table equals T[0]
import re
src = open("runtime/c/bcir_runtime.c").read()
body = src[src.index("static const uint32_t bcir_crc_table[256] = {"):]
body = body[:body.index("};")]
vals = [int(v, 16) for v in re.findall(r"0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})u", body)]
def bitwise(n):
    c = n
    for _ in range(8):
        c = (c >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320 & -(c & 1))
    return c & 0xFFFFFFFF
print(len(vals), vals == [bitwise(n) for n in range(256)])
EOF
